parsed.reason: Description A says the handler does not return after rejecting an invalid ETA, so execution falls through and the task runs immediately despite the rejection; it also notes the failure is never stored in the result backend. Description B says the mark_as_failure call was removed so no failure state is recorded in the result backend, leaving clients hanging. They overlap on the missing result-backend failure record, but A's primary defect is the missing return causing immediate execution, which B does not mention. B frames the issue as a removed call (a regression), while A frames it as a fall-through. The root cause differs: A is control-flow fall-through, B is missing failure recording.
